14478.meaning1: finds fault; looks down upon; thinks badly of

assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khiyyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
atha kho bhagavā sitaṃ pātv'ākāsi. atha kho tā devatāyo bhiyyosomattāya ujjhāyantiyo vehāsaṃ abbhuggañchuṃ.

14480.meaning1: found fault (with); looked down (upon); thought badly (of)

14489.meaning1: practice of gleaning; gathering food for subsistence
14489.meaning2: wandering for gleaning; walking in search of food pickings
14489.commentary: (DNa) ye pana saputtadārabhāvo nāma pabbajitassa ayutto'ti lāyanamaddanaṭṭhānesu vīhi-mugga-māsa-til'ādīni saṅkaḍḍhitvā pacitvā paribhuñjanti, te uñchācariyā nāma. (NIDD1a) uñchācariyāyā ti bhikkhācaraṇena.

examples.text: maddarājā cintesi sac'āhaṃ imaṃ ekassa dassāmi, sesarājāno kujjhissanti, mama dhītaraṃ rakkhissāmī'ti dhītarañ'ca bhariyañ'ca gahetvā aññātakavesena palāyitvā araññaṃ pavisitvā cūḷakāliṅgakumārassa assamapadato uparibhāge assamaṃ katvā pabbajitvā uñchācariyāya jīvikaṃ kappento tattha paṭivasati.

14490.meaning1: eating gleaned food; eating gathered food
14490.meaning2: involving eating by means of gleaning or begging
14490.commentary: (MNa) uñch'āsake vate ratā'ti uñchācariyasaṅkhāte bhikkhūnaṃ pakativate ratā, uccanīcagharadvāraṭṭhāyino hutvā kabaramissakaṃ bhattaṃ saṃharitvā paribhuñjantī'ti attho.

examples.text: santi kho pana me, udāyi, sāvakā piṇḍapātikā sapadānacārino uñch'āsake vate ratā, te antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhā samānā āsanena'pi nimantiyamānā na sādiyanti.

14494.meaning1: to be despised; to be disdained; should be looked down (on)

examples.text: cattāro kho me, mahārāja, daharā'ti na uññātabbā, daharā'ti na paribhotabbā. katame cattāro?
samaṇo kho daharo'ti na uññātabbo na paribhotabbo. daharo'pi c'esa samaṇo gotamo mah'iddhiko hoti mah'ānubhāvo, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ime pañhe puccheyyan'ti.

14496.meaning2: (also uṭṭhāpayati and uṭṭhāpeti) makes get up, rouses; makes rise, lifts, erects; makes appear, produces, lets rise, appear

14497.meaning2: having made stand up; having made rise
14497.commentary: (DNt) challiṃ uṭṭhapetvā'ti arogassa mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato upakkamena challiyā sakalikāya, papaṭikāya vā uṭṭhapanaṃ viya arogassa sāsanadhammassa tiṭṭhato byañjanamattena tappariyāpannaṃ viya hutvā challisadisaṃ pubbāparaviruddhatādidosaṃ uṭṭhapetvā paridīpetvā, tādisāni pana ek'aṃsato guḷhavessantar'ādi-pariyāpannāni hontī'ti āha guḷhavessantara… paññāyantī'ti attho'ti.

examples.text: na c'eva sutte osarantī'ti suttapaṭipāṭiyā katthaci anāgantvā challiṃ uṭṭhapetvā guḷhavessantara-guḷhaummagga-guḷhavinaya-vedallapiṭakānaṃ aññatarato āgatāni paññāyantī'ti attho. evaṃ āgatāni hi rāg'ādivinaye ca na paññāyamānāni chaḍḍetabbāni honti.

14498.meaning2: making stand up; making get up

14499.meaning1: gets up, makes an effort and strives for

examples.text: so uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati anavaññappaṭilābhāya lābha-sakkāra-siloka-ppaṭilābhāya
